title: Evercore Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Rise on Deal Activity
title_zh: Evercore 第二季度盈利未达预期，收入因交易活动而增长
summary: EVR posts record Q2 revenues on stronger deal activity and higher AUM, but rising expenses and special charges weighed on earnings.
summary_zh: 由于交易活动增强和资产管理规模增加，EVR 第二季度收入创历史新高，但费用和特殊费用的增加对收益造成了压力。

title: Anthropic-Meta AI Deal in the Cards? ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 人择-元人工智能交易即将到来？焦点ETF
summary: Anthropic's potential $10B AI computing deal with Meta could boost AI infrastructure demand and lift Meta-focused communication services ETFs like XLC and VOX.
summary_zh: Anthropic 与 Meta 潜在的 10B 美元人工智能计算交易可能会增加人工智能基础设施需求，并提振 XLC 和 VOX 等专注于 Meta 的通信服务 ETF。

title: Target the Red-Hot Spin-Off and Merger Space With These ETFs
title_zh: 通过这些 ETF 瞄准炙手可热的分拆和合并空间
summary: Spin-offs and mergers can lead to major movement for share prices, but accessing these scenarios can be challenging for investors; these ETFs can help.
summary_zh: 分拆和合并可能会导致股价大幅波动，但了解这些情况对投资者来说可能具有挑战性；这些 ETF 可以提供帮助。

title: M&A Deals Thriving in 2025: ETFs in Focus
title_zh: 2025 年并购交易蓬勃发展：ETF 成为焦点
summary: M&A deals are booming in 2025 despite fewer transactions -- megadeals, AI bets and Fed cuts may fuel ETFs like MNA, IAI, KBWB & CHAT.
summary_zh: 尽管交易量减少，但 2025 年并购交易仍将蓬勃发展——大型交易、人工智能押注和美联储降息可能会推动 MNA、IAI、KBWB 和 CHAT 等 ETF 的发展。
